flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google): Google Maps "King's Acres Campground" 3.7 from 309 reviews - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. Everything else passes; reviewer decides.

PRIVATE GATES: cheapest real electric night C$43 + GST (+C$5 booking fee per reservation): 15 A power/water lots F32-F36, max RV 24 ft (operator: '15 AMP POWER/WATER Maximum size limit: 24' RV - Tongue to Bumper DAILY: $43 -$45'). 30 A from C$56, peak pull-through C$71. Under C$69 without a gateway (gateways.py: none within 40 km; nearest Grasslands NP 267 km). RV Life 4*/$$$ as stored; Good Sam false as stored. Presence: own website + PitchCamp online booking.

LONG-STAY: all 95 lots are bookable online by the night (min 1-2 nights Apr-Dec); monthly rates posted for most types, a 'Sign a year's lease' special with storage sheds for long-term guests, and the quiet-hours rule says 'many guests are working, attending medical treatments'. Of the future reservations visible on 2026-11-18, the month-plus stays sit on ~14 lots (several 188-213-night winter stays on F22-F25). In winter (Jan-Apr 2027) most lots carry 7- to 40-night minimums - a seasonal minimum, not standing. Tests: (1) nightly sold, (2) nightly rates posted, (3) workforce wording present but not marketing, (4) ~100% nightly-bookable in season, (5) no lots sold. Passes; no wording that discourages nightly guests.
